correctness.rationale: Every homogeneous degree-three polynomial over F2 has an odd number of projective zeros by parity of the 16 affine evaluations. One rational tangent plane covers 7<15 projective points. Three planes cover all 15 iff they form the three members of a pencil through one rational line. Polarization of a cubic at three independent rational zeros forces the sum of their gradients nonzero, incompatible with the necessary pencil; hence three tangent-filling points must be collinear. For collinear points, Boolean cubic evaluation has six-dimensional kernel generated by Xi²Xj+XiXj², giving 64 cubics with that exact three-point zero set; their gradients along U depend linearly on U. Exact F2 column rank yields 44 rationally regular cubics, split 12 scheme-theoretically containing L and 32 not. Independently enumerated 576 line-preserving GL4(F2) transforms of both reps, yielding orbit sizes 12 and 32, and checked square-coordinate Jacobian matrices have full rank 4, so all orbit members geometrically smooth. Multiplying by 35 lines yields global orbits 420 and 1120, total1540; stabilizers 48,18. Additional source scripts were read but independent orbit enumeration was performed; finite exhaustive counting is genuinely exhaustive for the specified finite field.
